relations.subject: Walter Slaje
relations.role: subject specialist for Oriental Languages and Cultures and as head of the collection of scientific estates
relations.evidence: From 1984 to 1995, Slaje was employed at the University Library of Graz as a subject specialist for Oriental Languages and Cultures and as head of the collection of scientific estates.

relations.subject: Walter Slaje
relations.evidence: He studied Indology, Tibetology and Buddhism at the University of Vienna, where he was awarded a doctorate in 1983.

relations.subject: Walter Slaje
relations.evidence: After a stay as an Alexander von Humboldt Research Fellow at the University of Hamburg (1989–1991)

relations.subject: Walter Slaje
relations.evidence: he completed his habilitation in Indology at the University of Vienna in 1993.

relations.subject: Walter Slaje
relations.evidence: From October 1995 until his retirement in September 2019, he taught as tenured full professor of Indology at the Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg.

relations.subject: Walter Slaje
relations.evidence: In 2000, he was elected to the Administrative Board of the Helmuth von Glasenapp Foundation (Mainz), which he has chaired since 2020.

relations.subject: Walter Slaje
relations.object: Academy of Sciences and Literature in Mainz
relations.evidence: In 2002 he was elected Corresponding Member and in 2010 Full Member of the Academy of Sciences and Literature in Mainz.

relations.subject: Walter Slaje
relations.object: Centre for Historiography and Intellectual Culture of Kashmir
relations.evidence: Until its closure (2020) he acted as Director of the Centre for Historiography and Intellectual Culture of Kashmir

relations.subject: Walter Slaje
relations.evidence: He was elected chairman of the Deutsche Morgenländische Gesellschaft (DMG) from 2012 to 2021.

relations.subject: Walter Slaje
relations.evidence: From 1998 to 2009, he was the editor of the Indology section of the Zeitschrift der Deutschen Morgenländischen Gesellschaft (ZDMG).
